name: Charge
description: This app allows you to find EV chargers near you and use them! Currently, only Tesla Superchargers are supported.
author: thooton

changes.text: Publish packages into their catalog folders.
Back off failed charging session polls.
One token rotation per process however many stores, never landing on a newer setup; late results after the app starts over are dropped.
Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Sign out forgets the rotated Tesla tokens instead of adopting them again.
Set up from a setup file (Tesla refresh token, optional Maps key and regional settings); nothing private in the build.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Favorites opens on its first row, and Session asks Tesla again each time the app opens.
